lecture_12.title: CS336 Spring 2026, Lecture 12: Evaluation
lecture_12.note: Line anchors refer to the local shallow clone (sha256 recorded in discovered.json). Unlike lectures 2, 6 and 10 this file contains no @inspect values and no executable computation: it is 215 text() claims, 51 link() cites and 43 image() figures. So the only 'computed' material in this thread is what the author evaluates from the two formulas the professor writes down, perplexity (1/p(D))^(1/|D|) at L62 and the Elo win-probability 1/(1+10^((ELO_B-ELO_A)/400)) at L172; those evaluations are stated as 'evaluating the professor's formula gives'. Every count the professor reads off a paper in a text() line (57 subjects, 805 instructions, 2294 tasks, 2500 questions, 510 behaviors, 314 categories / 5694 prompts, 44 occupations, 121 tasks, 229 / 89 tasks, 40 CTF tasks, 75 competitions, 65% / 34% / 39% on GPQA, 'drop by 16% to 33%' on MMLU-Pro, 51.3 -> 30.0 on 1BW) is quoted with that attribution and never asserted as a fact of this thread. Numbers that live only inside embedded leaderboard screenshots and paper figures (artificial-analysis, lmarena-leaderboard, openrouter, gpt2-perplexity, mmlu, mmlu-pro, gpqa, hle-results, arena-beets, alpacaeval-leaderboard, wildbench, swebench, terminal-bench-*, cybench-*, mlebench-*, arc-agi-results, arc-agi-3-results, gdpval, clio-table4, contamination-exchangeability, the two Platinum tweets, karpathy-nanogpt-speedrun) are recorded as 'shown' and not restated.
